name: Slate Dark
description: A dark, app-owned look: cool slate surfaces, a toned block header, and the familiar blue accent. Does not follow the operating system's light/dark setting.
_note: Only what differs from Classic is listed; everything else is inherited. Because this preset knows its own surfaces, the semantic tints are re-tuned for a dark background instead of the both-themes compromise Classic has to make — they clear a far better contrast ratio here.
_metrics: Softer corners and a touch more room than Classic, which inherits the platform's tighter default padding.
